Directorate of Forensic Sciences Goa Recruitment 2026

Applications are invited from eligible candidates to fill various posts purely on a contractual basis.

Vacancy Details:
• Scientific Officer (SOC): 05 Posts (₹60,800/month)
• Scientific Assistant (DNA): 01 Post (₹48,800/month)
• Scientific Assistant: 05 Posts (₹48,800/month)
• Searcher (SOC): 01 Post (₹39,000/month)
• Photographer: 03 Posts (₹22,300/month)
• Videographer: 09 Posts (₹22,300/month)

Submission Details:
Application forms filled in the prescribed format along with self-attested copies of certificates must be submitted by hand or postal delivery to the Directorate of Forensic Sciences, Near Verna Police Station, Verna, Salcete, Goa 403722.

Application Period: 28/10/2026 to 17/11/2026 between 10.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m. and 2.30 p.m. to 5.30 p.m. on working days.

Official Portal: https://www.goa.gov.in
